null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero
comparability_and_attribution_limits: No continuous ten-year campus food-waste generation series was located in reviewed sources.
FY2025 is described as the first dedicated Dining Sustainability annual report; FY2026 is the second. This does not establish that older waste records do not exist.
Annual diversion, food generation, tracked consumption, production and donated meals are different metrics.
The FY2026 tonnage unit is not explicitly defined as short tons or metric tonnes.
FY2025 and FY2026 digestion quantities are close numerically if short tons are assumed, but rounding and scope do not support a precise annual percent change.
A decline in diverted tonnage can reflect attendance, capture coverage, contamination or operations rather than prevention.
Pandemic operations and changes excluding packaging break naive pre/post comparisons.
No annual tool-by-tool counterfactual or controlled attribution analysis was found.
Do not add tool claims, multiply a site percentage by campus waste, or annualize a 12-week pilot without an explicit model.
Other UMass campuses and state-wide waste figures were excluded.
data_needed_for_full_history: Office of Waste Management annual scale-ticket totals by material, site and FY2017-FY2026
Comparable pre-consumer and plate-waste weights with collection coverage
Annual admissions and meal counts matching the waste numerator
Metafoodx site/item exports with scan coverage and deployment dates
Historical weighing logs with instrument and category changes
FoodPro planned versus actual production sheets
Control or matched comparison sites and interventions timeline
null_policy: Missing values remain null; no interpolation, modeled replacement values or fabricated annual reductions are supplied.
